picks.editorial_note: DARPA and the Air Force successfully flew an AI agent autonomously controlling a modified F-16, a milestone in scalable autonomous air combat with direct implications for future military doctrine.
picks.title: DARPA and U.S. Air Force fly AI-controlled F-16, paving the way for autonomous air combat

picks.editorial_note: Berkeley Lab's American Science Cloud is the technical backbone of the national Genesis Mission, federating DOE data, models, and HPC resources to accelerate AI-driven science at unprecedented scale.
picks.title: How the Genesis Mission’s American Science Cloud Advances Innovation

picks.editorial_note: UCSF Health's new Converge accelerator, backed by Kleiner Perkins and Doerr Capital, embeds startups directly in a live clinical environment — a notable model for translating AI research into deployed healthcare tools.
picks.title: UCSF Health Partners to Launch New Model to Build Healthcare AI

picks.editorial_note: Cambridge's Whittle Laboratory summit brought together UK government, industry, and research leaders to chart an AI-driven revival of national hardware manufacturing in aerospace, energy, and defence.
picks.title: Landmark summit at Cambridge's new Whittle Laboratory aims to reignite Britain's industrial engine in aerospace, energy and defence

picks.editorial_note: A major philanthropic gift is establishing Georgia Tech's Petit Center for AI-Driven Health Innovation, a significant new funding commitment aimed at using AI to transform disease prediction and treatment.
picks.title: Georgia Tech Receives Commitment to Launch New AI-Driven Health Innovation Center

picks.editorial_note: Chulalongkorn University signed an MoU with NVIDIA and launched the Chula AI Center, a strategic industry partnership positioning Thailand as a regional AI research and talent hub.
picks.title: จุฬาฯ จัดงาน CU × NVAITC Symposium 2026 ลงนาม MoU เปิดตัว Chula AI Center

picks.editorial_note: Australia's Prime Minister used a University of Sydney address to announce a new government Office of AI and plans for mandatory national AI standards — a concrete national policy shift.
picks.title: Prime Minister delivers AI address at University of Sydney

picks.editorial_note: The National Academies' international workshop on AI-enabled biological threats addresses a critical dual-use policy question, shaping how biosecurity preparedness adapts to AI-accelerated biotechnology.
picks.title: Strengthening Preparedness Against Novel Biological Threat Agents Enabled Through Artificial Intelligence and Other Emerging Technologies

picks.editorial_note: A multi-institution EPFL-led collaboration (with SBB, Empa, ETH Zurich, and MIT) produced an AI forecasting model that materially improves grid-scale rail energy demand prediction for Switzerland's national rail operator.
picks.title: Using future data to better predict Switzerland's rail energy demand

picks.editorial_note: A new UC Santa Barbara-LLNL collaboration is applying AI to model extreme plasma physics, advancing simulation capability relevant to nuclear fusion and national security research.
picks.title: Lab Report: July 17, 2026 | Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory
